[project]
name = "project-monorepo"
version = "2.4.0"
description = ""
requires-python = ">=3.12, <3.13"
authors = [
  { name = "Robert Kania", email = "Robert.Kania@bpa.bund.de" }
]
readme = "README.md"

dependencies = [
  "shared",
  "asr-writer",
  "fs-watcher",
  "asr-service",
  "asr-service-openai-api",
  "asr-service-voxtral",
  "asr-service-qwen",
  "asr-service-whisper",
  "newscenter-addon",
  "web-service",
  "notify-service"
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
  "pytest>=8.4,<8.5",
  "pytest-asyncio>=0.26.0,<0.27.0",
  "cython~=3.1.6",
  "auto-changelog~=0.6.0",
  "lxml==6.0.2",
  "langdetect==1.0.9",
  "httpx==0.28.1",
  "aiosmtpd~=1.4.6",
  "psycopg2==2.9.11", # für postgres
  "toml==0.10.2",
  "pip2pi==0.8.2",
  "setuptools==80.0.0",
  "poethepoet>=0.42.1",
  "pytz==2026.3"
]
mkdocs = [
  "mkdocs>=1.6.1",
  "mkdocs-material>=9.7.6",
  "mkdocs-git-revision-date-localized-plugin>=1.5.1"
]

[tool.uv]
managed = true
package = false
index-strategy = "unsafe-first-match"
environments = ["sys_platform == 'linux'"]
# pyannote-audio 4 requires torchcodec unconditionally, but no torchcodec build
# exists for linux/aarch64 with the torch 2.8 pinned here (aarch64 wheels start at
# 0.11, which needs torch 2.11). Re-apply whisperx's own marker so arm64 runners can
# sync; the DGX image (torch 2.10) installs a matching +cu130 build from the pytorch
# index -- see images/asr-service/pyproject.cu130.toml.
override-dependencies = [
  "torch==2.8.0; (sys_platform == 'linux' and platform_machine == 'x86_64') or sys_platform == 'darwin' or sys_platform == 'win32'",
  "torchaudio==2.8.0; (sys_platform == 'linux' and platform_machine == 'x86_64') or sys_platform == 'darwin' or sys_platform == 'win32'",
=====
{
  "name": "audiominer",
  "version": "2.4.0",
  "description": "",
  "workspaces": [
    "packages/*_ui"
  ],
  "devDependencies": {
    "@mdx-js/rollup": "^3.1.1",
    "@preact/preset-vite": "^2.10.6",
    "eslint": "^10.9.1",
    "sass": "^1.103.1",
    "sass-loader": "^17.0.0",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2",
    "vite": "^8.2.2"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "./scripts/build-npm.sh"
  },
  "private": true
}
